candidateLedger.canonicalClaim: A provenance-confirmed, non-injected cooperative ghost can have an identifiable frozen-state planner effect with an independently defined safety direction.
A message-defined coalition can benefit while imposing actor-wise closed-loop burden on fixed outsiders that changes admission or fallback decisions beyond average welfare.
Natural trajectories may exhibit an empirical gap between earliest calibrated response identification and an independently computed last-safe intervention time.
A declarative semantic manifest negotiates safe fusion and fallback across rolling heterogeneous models.
Receiver-observable occlusion and point support identify a conditional V2U collaboration value after distance and timing controls.
Adaptive vehicle micro-actions substitute for removed explicit cooperation messages and reveal message overvaluation.
Shared backbones and training data increase cross-agent error correlation and reduce fusion benefit at fixed marginal quality.
Receiver-visible objects provide a natural non-regression slice for detecting harmful cooperative fusion.

hardGateEvidence.naturalProblem: A formal primary paper establishes a non-injected low-nonzero-noise fusion ghost mechanism; the claim remains simulation-specific until MDrive occurrence is measured.
hardGateEvidence.irreducibleResidual: Per-box removal and planner-aware metrics are occupied, leaving only the combined occurrence, fusion-provenance, immutable-state and normative-safety audit.
hardGateEvidence.identifiableMinimumExperiment: Freeze the occurrence ledger before action inspection, attribute each event with primary-only and leave-one-cooperator-out replay, then compare original and remove-only planner branches against no-op, matched and GT-oracle controls.
hardGateEvidence.credibleBuildPath: The fixed MDrive code exposes every required handoff; miners, provenance replay and state restoration are bounded self-built modules rather than missing core assets.

hardGateEvidence.naturalProblem: MDrive reports naturally negative negotiation outcomes in dense traffic and supplies reactive non-member actors, but the outsider-specific effect remains unisolated.
hardGateEvidence.irreducibleResidual: Generic counterfactual harm, minimal disruption and social welfare are occupied; the residual is the pre-message membership-conditioned actor-wise externality and whether it changes a decision.
hardGateEvidence.identifiableMinimumExperiment: Freeze actor roster and coalition before the first message, verify identical pre-treatment worlds, and compare complete closed-loop policy assignments with actor-level outcomes and independent response cohorts.
hardGateEvidence.credibleBuildPath: MDrive exposes negotiation/no-negotiation runs, seeds, reactive traffic and actor state; snapshot equality and actor-wise export are bounded self-built instrumentation.

hardGateEvidence.naturalProblem: InterHub contains large natural merge and crossing cohorts with causal prefixes; it does not yet prove that reliable response identification arrives after the last safe intervention.
hardGateEvidence.irreducibleResidual: Intent prediction, delayed reveal, LSIT and reachability are occupied separately; the residual is their jointly estimated, data-separated natural actionability-gap distribution and decision consequence.
hardGateEvidence.identifiableMinimumExperiment: Estimate t_identifiable from calibrated causal-prefix models and t_last_safe from label-independent dynamics and map constraints, with source-held-out splits, censoring and a reachability fallback baseline.
hardGateEvidence.credibleBuildPath: InterHub fixed code and mini data establish the interface; a causal-prefix builder, calibrator and reachability evaluator are credible self-built research modules.

reasons: DDS-XTypes occupies declarative type identity and assignability, while HyDRA already detects latent domain mismatch and routes to late fusion.
A static manifest cannot identify latent feature semantics; adding pair-level outcomes turns it into an empirical compatibility matrix or allowlist.
The formal split exposes only nine validation and nine test sequences; a strict confirmation design has n=9 and power only for very large effects before stratification.
Distance and sync/async effects are already reported, while receiver-observable residual strata and same-object three-arm pairing remain unverified.
Driving micro-actions as implicit communication, explicit-versus-implicit substitution and response-mediated agent effects already have direct functional priors.
The proposed visibility intervention also mixes communication removal with changed physical dynamics and policy class.
Ensemble covariance, majority-vote diversity and direct cooperative-perception diversity optimization occupy the core estimand.
No verified natural system evidence isolates shared training lineage as the cause at fixed marginal error quality.
Receiver-visible non-regression is a useful slice but does not establish a new mechanism beyond existing negative-cooperation and planner-aware evaluation work.
The candidate lacks a unique intervention or decision consequence after the ghost-provenance and outsider-externality residuals are separated.

conclusion: Three candidates survive only as narrow, falsifiable dossiers: provenance-confirmed benign ghost planning effects, membership-conditioned outsider externalities, and the empirical intent-actionability timing gap. Shortlist status authorizes dossier construction and blind review; it is not a score or publication decision. Every other candidate is closed by direct functional priors, insufficient independent support, or a missing identifiable mechanism.
